title: UX Page Read v1
description: One render of one public URL in a fresh anonymous browser context: rung R3 of the public-page reader. Written by a render driver (drivers/web/read_page.mjs, owned by the ergonomics session) or assembled from a capture in the researcher's own private window, and consumed by `ux_research.py ingest`, which accepts it only after an anonymous read of the same URL that did not stop. The render never types, clicks or presses keys; it only scrolls, waits at most 15 s for checks that clear by themselves, keeps the browser's own identity and uses no stealth. An interactive challenge or a login form is reported, never solved.

status.description: HTTP status of the main document; 0 when unknown

text.description: document.body.innerText after scrolling; at most 400 KB

json_ld.description: JSON-LD blocks as parsed values or raw strings; at most 10 blocks and 1 MB in total

robots.description: content of the robots meta tag

tdm_reservation.description: content of the tdm-reservation meta tag or header

interactive.description: an interactive human check (a widget, a press-and-hold, a picture puzzle) was on the page

login_form.description: a password field was on the page

context.description: a fresh context with no stored cookies or sign-in
